about.title: Built on reliability, driven by service.
text: Proudly serving the Greater Houston area, Triumph Industrial Supply delivers fast, dependable solutions to the petrochemical and construction industries. Founded by fourth-generation industry leaders, we bring over 50 years of experience and a hands-on approach to every order.
From tools and materials to safety gear and site essentials, our mission is simple: keep your job running with unmatched service, speed, and expertise.

Triumph was formed in 2013 as part of the BAM Industrial Group, alongside Baytown Ace Industrial Services and Production Metal Sawing & Processing. In 2023 we moved into our own facilities at 55 W Main St in Baytown.

facts.heading: BAM Industrial Group History
items: 1971: Original Baytown Ace Machine shop was built at 1001 E Fayle St., Baytown, TX
1990: New shop and offices built at 1102 S. Hwy. 146, Baytown, TX
1997: Addition to back of building for mechanic shop at 1102 S. Hwy. 146
2001: Addition to east side of building for small lathes, CNC, and balancing
2008: Purchase of land and addition to west side of building for warehouse and fabrication shop
2012: Addition of new offices to the front of building
2013: Name change for Baytown Ace Machine to Baytown Ace Industrial Services to align better with new services provided
2013: Triumph Industrial Supply formed and housed at 1102 S. Hwy 146
2018: Acquisition of long-time vendor Production Metal Sawing and name change to Production Metal Sawing and Processing at 7215 Canal St., Houston, TX
2023: Triumph moves into new facilities at 55 W. Main St., Baytown, TX

facts.heading: Privacy Policy
items: Last updated October 29, 2026, and published at triumphindustrial.com
Our store and website are powered by Shopify, which processes personal information in order to provide and improve the services
Information we collect or process includes contact, payment, account, transaction, communication, device and usage details
Depending on where you live you may have rights to access, delete, correct or receive a copy of your personal information
You can opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information for targeted advertising, and we honor the Global Privacy Control signal
Promotional emails can be stopped at any time with the unsubscribe option in our emails
The services are not intended for children under the age of majority
Privacy questions and requests go to sales@triumphindustrial.com
